name: Pompu (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pompu (the letter P on red above a wheat sheaf on light blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Pompu, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pompu arms — letter P on red above a wheat sheaf on light blue, crowned, within branches
